title: Beatrix and the Contact
author: Casper Iversen
blurb: Sebastian Iversen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
